name: Falling Maple Leaves
description: Red maple leaves falling over the video, spinning down on the wind.

params.name: mode
params.description: Motion: 0 tumble (spin round, carried by the wind), 1 pendulum swing, 2 spiral, 3 no swing (wind still drifts), 4 custom path from path_x, path_y and angle

params.name: count
params.description: Number of leaf slots; strong wind carries part of them outside the frame

params.name: speed
params.description: Fall speed, frame heights per second

params.name: wind
params.description: Sideways drift, frame heights per second (negative blows left)

params.name: size
params.description: Smallest and largest leaf, in frame heights

params.name: offset
params.description: Seconds added to the time (e.g. to keep the leaves in place after -ss)

params.name: life
params.description: Mode 4: seconds a leaf lives before it respawns

params.name: path_x
params.description: Mode 4: x of the leaf centre in frame heights (0 left, w right). t time, u seconds since the leaf appeared, p = u/life, i slot, r0..r3 random per leaf, x0 random in 0..w, w frame width and h frame height (1) in frame heights

params.name: path_y
params.description: Mode 4: y of the leaf centre in frame heights (0 top, 1 bottom); same variables as path_x

params.name: angle
params.description: Mode 4: rotation in degrees; same variables as path_x
